# libunwind / fuzz_libunwind

OSS-Fuzz's fuzz target `fuzz_libunwind` ([source](source/fuzz_libunwind.c), unmodified) over libunwind (libunwind/libunwind at 54326ba7).

Input bytes (12..512) steer a mutual recursion (recurse1-4 via dispatch) that, at fuzz-chosen depths, unwinds the live stack with unw_getcontext/unw_init_local/unw_step and calls unw_get_proc_name, unw_get_reg (fuzz register number), unw_is_signal_frame or unw_get_save_loc; all return values ignored.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against libunwind at commit 54326ba7.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
The harness makes no check of its own beyond not crashing, so a statement about it says only that the code it calls never crashes, hangs or trips a sanitizer.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch libunwind` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| plain | `fuzz_libunwind.plain` | 149,496 | `d3e760645d38b818cb4cfba50496606f9e44e92cbf3e09d14d5ac4583cfae4e6` |
| ubsan | `fuzz_libunwind.ubsan` | 157,320 | `1871227126309efaa7c3f54248c5b8137dc40d94bdd0f4ab3fab0e046a245cc6` |
| asan | `fuzz_libunwind.asan` | 736,832 | `8d94cf813c2dad802dbf79905c5bdaccb0e504cb85701d567c57041f92b2d9fa` |
| asan-ubsan | `fuzz_libunwind.asan-ubsan` | 744,832 | `578961dc680dfa709649839bb951e37badad37e942f8707c026c347d9a947c4c` |

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `liblzma.a` (a library from the build image)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `liblzma.a` (a library from the build image)
- asan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `liblzma.a` (a library from the build image), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
- asan-ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `liblzma.a` (a library from the build image), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
